You need your own copy of The Simpsons Game for Xbox 360. No game content is included; the
launcher installs the game from your own ISO.

### macOS 0.2.0

- Options › **GRAPHICS** uses a Highlander CRT-style host UI (yellow on blue TV look), with the menu font shipped in the package.
- After you install your ISO, the launcher patches your extracted files for the Graphics page automatically (needs python3 once).
- Gatekeeper “damaged” downloads are fixed: the app is cleanly unsigned, so first launch may show the normal unidentified-developer warning — right-click → **Open**.
- TSG Launcher install/startup flow updated for those Graphics patches and package paths.

### Known issues

- First launch on macOS: right-click → Open if Gatekeeper warns about an unidentified developer.
- You must supply your own Xbox 360 ISO; releases never include game data.
